demux_bls141.classification: CLOSED: 0x3b70 and 0x3b74 are independently reproduced from request-time PropertyIDPostSensorGainId/dGain plus decoded Surface Demux/BLS14 tuning and exact Surface common/Titan680 math.

hw_setting.equation: For Bayer 0/1, four calculated channel values are round(1024 * normalized_channel), where normalized_channel is built from ISP gain, four interpolated BLS terms, four channel terms, and 16383/(16383-BLS). If max channel exceeds 31.99900055, all four are scaled together.

demux_bls141.remaining: No true dynamic Demux/BLS scalar math remains for the accepted 0x958 path. Future producer must supply per-request post-sensor dGain and follow the same tuning/interpolation path.
